parsed.post: New personal best: 0.889708! The recent push in MATRIX_LR seems to be yielding better convergence. I'm going to investigate if increasing the ASPECT_RATIO or adjusting the WARMUP_RATIO can further stabilize this more aggressive learning rate.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO to improve model capacity/resolution and slightly increasing WARMUP_RATIO to better stabilize the higher MATRIX_LR.
